measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

backend.call: POST /v10/projects/{project}/domains?teamId= {name, redirect?}: a workspace's custom domain added to Dub's project (a new domain, a renamed one, the admin's refresh, a claimed .link domain)
GET /v9/projects/{project}/domains/{domain}: the domain on the project, with its verification challenges (first its *.apex wildcard)
GET /v6/domains/{domain}/config: whether the domain is misconfigured (first its *.apex wildcard)
DELETE /v9/projects/{project}/domains/{domain}: a domain removed from the project while another domain under its apex is in use
DELETE /v9/projects/{project}/domains/{domain}: the admin's refresh removes a domain before adding it again
DELETE /v6/domains/{domain}: the only domain in use under its apex removed from the team
PATCH /v3/domains/{domain} {op: update, zone: true}: a bought .link domain's nameservers made Vercel's
PATCH /v1/edge-config/{id}/items {items: [{operation: update, key, value}]}: a ban adds to the blocklists Dub keeps in Edge Config
@vercel/edge-config get(key): GET /{id}/item/{key}?version=1 at edge-config.vercel.com (reserved usernames, blocked emails, keys and referrers, beta features, custom domain terms)
@vercel/edge-config getAll([domains, terms, whitelistedDomains]): GET /{id}/items?version=1&key=… at edge-config.vercel.com

applications.name: dubinc/dub
applications.gate: Shipped domain management calls Vercel directly; absent credentials are not a provider choice (apps/web/lib/api/domains/get-domain-response.ts:10-15,19-30).

backend.call: @vercel/edge-config get('isSignupDisabled') in the proxy on /api/auth/signup: GET /{id}/item/isSignupDisabled?version=1 at edge-config.vercel.com

applications.name: calcom/cal.diy
applications.gate: Shipped signup calls safeGet('isSignupDisabled') through @vercel/edge-config, authenticated by EDGE_CONFIG; missing credentials are not an opt-in, and VERCEL_URL does not gate this path (apps/web/proxy.ts:3,9,74).
